name: shop
description: Ask about your Shop Bot store in plain language: sales reports, what needs attention, catalog and licence-key stock, orders and Stars payments, and support tickets, read through the store's own MCP server with your API token.

mcp_url.title: Store MCP address
mcp_url.description: Your store's MCP address, ending in /api/merchant/v1/mcp. The store bot prints it with every new token (/apitoken). Use https:// for any host that is not this machine.

api_token.title: Store API token
api_token.description: A token you create in a private chat with your store bot (/apitoken new <name>), starting with shp_. Sent only as the Authorization: Bearer header to the MCP address above, and kept in Claude Code's secure storage, not in settings.json.
